summary: Historical scoreboard sync must query ESPN by month (dates=YYYYMM) or day, never by a dates=START-END range, and a failed chunk must fail the command.
reason: Since 2026-09-15 ESPN's site API rejects every scoreboard date range with HTTP 400; the fetch error was swallowed, so sync --dates exited 0 with 0 events. The accepted date forms are an ESPN moving target a regen must re-verify.
validated_outcome: Live 2026-09-27: football/nfl 20260924-20261111 went from 0 events (three HTTP 400s) to 48+60+71 = 179; the tests fail on the range form and on a swallowed chunk error.
